description: A male Imperial Assassin found at the Dawnstar Sanctuary.

description: A Nord Assassin found at the Dawnstar Sanctuary.

description: A Nord Assassin found at the Dawnstar Sanctuary.

description: A female Nord vampire found during the quest Awakening. Forced follower during Bloodline, Chasing Echoes, Beyond Death, Unseen Visions, Touching the Sky, Kindred Judgment. (Vampire class)

name: Frea
howToObtain: Prerequisite quest: The Fate of the Skaal
description: A female Nord warrior from Skaal Village. Temporary follower during The Temple of Miraak.

name: Talvas Fathryon
description: A male Dunmer conjurer, spell merchant, and master Conjuration trainer found in Tel Mithryn.

name: Teldryn Sero
description: A male Dunmer Spellsword found in the Retching Netch in Raven Rock. Can be hired for 500 gold.

name: Ralis Sedarys
description: A male Dunmer miner initially found at Kolbjorn Barrow.

description: A male Nord Warrior (1H) found in Hillgrund's Tomb.

name: Illia
description: A female Imperial Mage found in Darklight Tower.

name: Belrand
description: A male Nord Spellsword found in the Winking Skeever in Solitude.

name: Erik the Slayer
description: A male Nord Barbarian found in Rorikstead at the Frostfruit Inn after completing his quest.

name: Jenassa
description: A female Dunmer Ranger found inside the Drunken Huntsman in Whiterun.

name: Marcurio
description: A male Imperial Destruction Mage found at The Bee and Barb in Riften.

name: Stenvar
description: A male Nord Warrior (2H) in Windhelm (usually on the second floor of Candlehearth Hall).

name: Vorstag
description: A male Nord Warrior (1H) found at the Silver-Blood Inn in Markarth.

name: Argis the Bulwark
howToObtain: Prerequisite quest: Become Thane of the Reach
description: A male Nord found in Markarth.

name: Calder

description: A male Nord found in Windhelm.

name: Gregor

description: A female Nord found in Whiterun.

name: Rayya

description: A female Redguard found in Falkreath.

name: Valdimar
howToObtain: Prerequisite quest: Become Thane of Hjaalmarch
description: A male Nord found in Morthal.

name: Borgakh the Steel Heart
howToObtain: Prerequisite quest: Pay her dowry or pass a persuade check.
description: A female Orc Warrior found in Mor Khazgur.

name: Ghorbash the Iron Hand
howToObtain: Prerequisite quest: Convince him (via brawl, persuade check, or bribe).
description: A male Orc Ranger found in Dushnikh Yal.

name: Lob
description: A male Orc Ranger found in Largashbur.

name: Ogol
description: A male Orc Warrior found in Largashbur.

name: Ugor
description: A female Orc Ranger in Largashbur.

name: Adelaisa Vendicci
howToObtain: Prerequisite quest: Rise in the East
description: A female Imperial who works for the East Empire Company.

name: Ahtar
howToObtain: Prerequisite quest: Kill the Bandit Leader
description: A male Redguard Warrior who is found in Solitude.

name: Annekke Crag-Jumper
howToObtain: Prerequisite quest: Kill the Bandit Leader
description: A female Nord Ranger found in Darkwater Crossing.

name: Aranea Ienith
howToObtain: Prerequisite quest: The Black Star (in her favor)
description: A female Dunmer Conjuration Mage found at the Shrine of Azura.

name: Benor
description: A male Nord Warrior found in Morthal.

name: Cosnach
howToObtain: Prerequisite quest: Quest all Drunks Have (or) Fight! Fight!
description: An alcoholic male Breton Warrior (1H) found in Markarth.

name: Derkeethus
description: A male Argonian Ranger found in Darkwater Pass.

name: Eola
howToObtain: Prerequisite quest: The Taste of Death
description: A female Breton Nightblade found in Markarth's Hall of the Dead.

name: Erandur
howToObtain: Prerequisite quest: Waking Nightmare (in his favor)
description: A male Dunmer Priest found in Dawnstar.

name: Faendal
howToObtain: Prerequisite quest: A Lovely Letter (in his favor)
description: A male Bosmer Thief found in Riverwood. He is a common Archery trainer.

name: Kharjo
howToObtain: Prerequisite quest: Amulet of the Moon
description: A male Khajiit Warrior traveling between cities in Ahkari's Khajiit caravan.

name: Mjoll the Lioness
description: A female Nord Warrior found in Riften.

name: Roggi Knot-Beard
description: A male Nord Miner found in Kynesgrove.

name: Sven
howToObtain: Prerequisite quest: A Lovely Letter (in his favor)
description: A male Nord Bard found in Riverwood.

name: Uthgerd the Unbroken
description: A female Nord Warrior found in The Bannered Mare in Whiterun.

name: Armored Troll
howToObtain: Can be purchased from Gunmar in Fort Dawnguard for 500 gold. You may be given an Armored Frost Troll instead.

name: Armored Frost Troll
howToObtain: Can be purchased from Gunmar in Fort Dawnguard for 500 gold. You may be given an Armored Troll instead.

name: Bran
howToObtain: An armored husky in Fort Dawnguard.

name: CuSith
howToObtain: A Death Hound in Volkihar Keep.

name: Garmr
howToObtain: A Death Hound in Volkihar Keep.

name: Meeko
howToObtain: A dog that can be found at Meeko's Shack.

name: Sceolang
howToObtain: An armored husky in Fort Dawnguard.

name: Stray Dog
howToObtain: These can be found in a random encounter in the wilderness. If you talk to one, it will become your follower. Note: Is prone to disappearing on changing cells, being told to wait, or being told to go home unless already claimed as a pet by an adopted child.

name: Vigilance
howToObtain: A dog which can be purchased from Banning at the Markarth stables for 500 gold. As with the hirelings, if you dismiss Vigilance, he will return to Banning and you must pay the 500 gold again to get him back.

name: Riekling, Riekling Hunter, Riekling Scout or Riekling Warrior
description: A Riekling which can be recruited at Thirsk Mead Hall after completing The Chief of Thirsk Hall.

name: Steadfast Dwarven Sphere
description: Friendly Dwarven automatons found in Kagrumez during The Kagrumez Gauntlet.

name: Hand Ethra Mavandas
description: A female Dunmer "dremora", found in Ashfall's Tear.

name: Hand Kydren Indobar
description: A male Dunmer "dremora", found in Ashfall's Tear.

name: Rulnik Wind-Strider
description: A male Nord Sorcerer, found in the Temple of Kynareth.

name: Vesparth the Toe
description: A female Dunmer Warrior, found in Ashfall's Tear.

name: Watchman Sindras
description: A male Dunmer "blade binder" warrior, found in Ashfall's Tear.

name: Arachnia
howToObtain: Can be found in Cronvangr Cave with the Pets of Skyrim Creation.

name: Bone Wolf
howToObtain: Can be found at a camp northwest of Folgunthur with the Bone Wolf Creation. It can be tamed with a Totem Bone.

name: Demented Elytra Nymph
howToObtain: Can be found at the Seducers Bandit camp northwest of Windhelm with the Saints & Seducers Creation.

name: Dwarven Armored Mudcrab
howToObtain: Can be purchased from Calcelmo in the Understone Keep in Markarth with Dwarven Armored Mudcrab Creation.

name: Hilda
howToObtain: Can be purchased from Halvar in Rorikstead with the Pets of Skyrim Creation.

name: Manic Elytra Nymph
howToObtain: Can be found at the Saints Bandit camp just west of North Brittleshin Pass entrance with the Saints & Seducers Creation.

name: Nix-Hound
howToObtain: Can be found purchased from Revus Sarvani or Geldis Sadri with the Nix-Hound Creation.

name: Skritch
howToObtain: Can be found in The Ratway below Riften with the Pets of Skyrim Creation.

name: Sweet Roll
howToObtain: Can be found in a forest southwest of Half-Moon Mill with the Pets of Skyrim Creation. It can be tamed with a Sweet Roll.

name: Thistle
howToObtain: Can be found at the Alchemist's Shack with the Pets of Skyrim Creation. It can be tamed with a Carrot.

name: Gogh
howToObtain: Can be found in the Gromm's Pass with the Goblins Creation. If the Blue God is slain and he is freed from the pit, he can be recruited as a follower.

name: Aela the Huntress
howToObtain: Quests: The Silver Hand, Totems of Hircine
description: Will replace your permanent follower, however your follower can be recruited later.

name: Anska
description: Follows you through High Gate Ruins.

name: Avulstein Gray-Mane
description: If asked to join the jailbreak at Northwatch Keep, he will follow you alongside Vidrald and Geirlund until you reach his brother Thorald and leave the fort.

name: Babette
description: She and Nazir will briefly follow you until you reach Astrid.

name: Blades Recruits
description: The three NPCs whom you chose to join the Blades will accompany you to kill a dragon.

name: Brother Verulus
description: In order to recruit him, you must first pass a speech check.

name: Brynjolf
description: After talking to Karliah outside Nightingale Hall, he starts following you. He will also follow you during Blindsighted.

name: Chief Yamarz
description: If he survives after slaying the giant, calming him down will have him follow you. However the effect will only last a minute. Using console commands can allow him to permanently follow you.

name: Delphine
description: She will accompany you and Esbern up to Sky Haven Temple if you choose to travel with them during Alduin's Wall.

name: Derkeethus
description: Once you free him, he will follow you until you exit Darkwater Pass.

name: Durian
description: Will follow you if leave the cave without finishing the quest.

name: Enmon
description: Enmon may join you when you offer to liberate Fjotra from her Forsworn captors.

name: Eola
description: Follows you through Reachcliff Cave until you reach the Namira shrine (if allowed to accompany you).

name: Esbern
howToObtain: Quests: A Cornered Rat, Alduin's Wall
description: Esbern will follow you wherever you go in A Cornered Rat, but when he joins up with Delphine in Alduin's Wall he will only stay with you as long as you are heading toward the wall, which then prevents him from being used in most other quests. He will accompany you and Delphine up to Sky Haven Temple if you choose to travel with them during Alduin's Wall.

name: Farkas
howToObtain: Quests: Proving Honor, Purity, Dragon Seekers
description: Will replace your permanent follower, even while he is waiting for you at Dustman's Cairn, you can recruit a follower for the latter two. Once you meet up with him, he will follow you everywhere.

name: Fenrig
description: He will appear once you get near Gjukar's Monument, but you will need to fast travel as quickly as possible for him to follow you.

name: Fjotra
description: Fjotra will follow you once you rescue her from her captives.

name: Galmar Stone-Fist
description: Once you enter Whiterun, he and Ralof will follow you until you enter Dragonsreach.

name: Geirlund
description: He meets up with you alongside Vidrald when you meet Avulstein Gray-Mane outside of Northwatch Keep (if you agreed to have him along to help you).

name: Golldir
description: Agree to accompany him to kill Vals Veran.

name: Hadvar
howToObtain: Quests: Unbound, Rescue from Fort Kastav
description: Accompanies you if you chose him during the opening sequence in Helgen. If you side with the Imperials in the Civil War, he will also follow you during Rescue from Fort Kastav.

name: Imperial Soldiers
description: 4 Imperial Soldiers will follow you once you rescue them, once you reach the courtyard they will stop following you.

name: Karliah
description: After talking to her in Irkngthand, she starts following you.

name: Katria
description: Katria can be used for other quests, but only by breaking her own quest, which is fixable but not advisable.

name: Malborn
description: If you save him, he will follow you around the Thalmor Embassy up until you escape.

name: Maurice Jondrelle
description: After retrieving Nettlebane and talking to Danica Pure-Spring, he will engage you in conversation and ask to come with you.

name: Mercer Frey
description: Follows after helping you break into Snow Veil Sanctum.

name: Nazir
description: He and Babette will briefly follow you until you find Astrid.

name: Orthorn
description: Free him from his cell, and talk to him.

name: Ralof
howToObtain: Quests: Unbound, Rescue from Fort Neugrad, Battle for Whiterun (Stormcloaks)
description: Accompanies you if you chose him during the opening sequence in Helgen. If you side with the Stormcloaks in the Civil War, he will follow you during Rescue from Fort Neugrad.

name: Rescued NPC (random)
description: An NPC that has been rescued will follow you until you reach their destination.

name: Serana
howToObtain: Quests: Bloodline, Chasing Echoes, Beyond Death, Unseen Visions, Touching the Sky, Kindred Judgment
description: In Bloodline, she is a regular quest follower. In later quests, she will take orders and trade items like a permanent follower and takes up the follower slot, but cannot be dismissed. Between certain quests, she may be dismissed and told to walk ahead to the next location.

name: Sinding
description: Briefly follows you for the duration of the quest, if you choose to spare him and turn the tables on the hunters. He will be in werewolf form, and is capable of flinging opponents across distances much like a player werewolf, although his throw attack is not fatal.

name: Stormcloak Soldiers
description: 4 Stormcloak Soldiers will follow you once you rescue them, they will stop following you once you reach the courtyard.

name: Stormcloak Soldier
description: Agree to have him follow you to reach to the Hall of Valor.

name: Tolfdir
howToObtain: Quests: Under Saarthal, The Eye of Magnus
description: Will follow you in Saarthal and to help defeat Ancano.

name: Thonnir
description: He will follow you alongside other residents of Morthal through Movarth's Lair, if allowed.

name: Thorald Gray-Mane
description: If he dies, you will fail the quest. Avulstein Gray-Mane, Geirlund, and Vidrald will also stop following you.

name: Traveling Bard, Traveling Merchant or Traveling Pilgrim
description: Persuade the Dawnguard member to follow you.

name: Traveling Bard, Traveling Pilgrim, or Visiting Advisor
description: Persuade the vampire to follow you.

name: Valdr
description: After healing him, you can opt for him to accompany you into the cavern.

name: Veezara
description: He will briefly follow you before telling you to escape.

name: Vidrald
description: He meets up with you alongside Geirlund when you meet Avulstein Gray-Mane outside of Northwatch Keep (if you agreed to have him along to help you).

name: Vilkas
howToObtain: Quests: Purity of Revenge, Purity, Dragon Seekers
description: Will replace your permanent follower but you can recruit your follower again for the latter two.

name: Barbas
description: Barbas is the only temporary dog follower in the game. He can tag along for however long you wish if you start the quest but don't complete it. He frequently barks, whines, and pushes you, however he is invincible and will continue to follow and fight for you no matter where you bring him.

name: Gleda the Goat
description: Gleda will not fight, and cannot be spoken to. She will follow you until you return her to Ennis.

name: Bujold the Unworthy
description: She will follow you inside Hrothmund's Barrow.

name: Frea
description: Accompanies you through the majority of the Temple of Miraak.

name: Neloth
description: Neloth will only follow you in Nchardak Aqueduct.

name: Tharstan
description: Follows you through Vahlok's Tomb. Will not fight.

name: Bilgemuck
howToObtain: Quests: The Chief of Thirsk Hall
description: He will briefly follow you until he reaches the riekling pen next to the forge (Bilgemuck will follow you around Solstheim but will leave or disappear in Skyrim and will only appear when fast travel).
